family: MiniLM-L6 sentence encoder with numeric prefix embeddings (text plus numbers)
inputs: short scene text (goal, contact, route) as tokens; 72 lidar bins (circular conv) and the route values as prefix embeddings
outputs: continuous (v, omega) at speed level 2 (or one of the 8 actions)
license: Apache-2.0 (to be confirmed on the model card at download)
